info.name: Asset Graph Account Management Risks API

params.name: risk_id
params.description: A Censys risk ID (e.g. CENSYS-2025-1), threat ID (e.g. THREAT-1) or an external risk identifier (e.g. CVE-2025-00001)

items.docs: Retrieve additional metadata for a risk, such as long-form descriptions and references. Risk IDs can be found on asset data in vulnerabilities, exposures, misconfigurations, and threats.
